title: MCP Parameter-Description Ablation: Null-Result Experiment Dataset
description: Supplementary dataset for a pre-registered ablation experiment testing whether moving parameter-level detail out of an MCP tool's description string and into inputSchema.properties[*].description regresses parameter-filling accuracy, especially for smaller models. Contains two experiments: (1) exp1-analyze-symbol, a 320-call run across two models (claude-haiku-4-5, claude-sonnet-5) in a 2x2 cell design (rich vs. lean tool description; param detail in tool description vs. input schema), blind-scored at two scoring resolutions; the pre-registered Mann-Whitney U primary test found no significant parameter-filling difference for either model (haiku U=720, p=0.372; sonnet U=820, p=0.569, n=40/cell), while input tokens per call dropped significantly for the lean description (p<0.001 both models, ~45% tool-description token reduction); (2) exp2-response-format, a collapse A/B of response-shaping parameters into a single response_format enum (2 arms x 2 tools x 2 models), also null on parameter-filling (haiku p=0.335, sonnet p=0.242, n=40/cell) with a significant but small token saving. Includes fixtures, prompts, rubrics, scorer prompts, raw call transcripts, blind scores, and pre-registered protocols locked before scoring.
notes: Both experiments were blind-scored: raw transcripts were scored with the model identity and cell assignment masked. Primary tests were pre-registered before data collection; sensitivity and exploratory analyses are labeled as such in the analysis files.
